headline: Four days to the lockout: King, Suzuki, Arozarena and Morejon are still unsigned, Suzuki wants more than Sato's $120M, and the second-tier starters are flying off the board.

news.title: Suzuki wants to top Sato's $120 million
news.note: Heyman reports Suzuki's agency told suitors he wants more than Sato's guarantee; MLBTR projected four years, $105M. The Blue Jays, Padres and Phillies are linked to him and Arozarena.

news.title: Rangers sign Bryce Johnson to a minor-league deal
news.note: A glove-first switch-hitting outfielder for depth while Evan Carter recovers from hip surgery. Texas still hasn't signed a major-league free agent this winter.
The NL MVP topped Skenes' 2025 mark; Misiorowski and Schlittler were next. MLB proposes growing the $50M pool to $65M; the union wants $180M.
news.title: Crow-Armstrong sets the pre-arb bonus pool record: $3.55 million

news.note: Ginkel gets two years, $18M (Feinsand). Puk gets one year, $5M in Washington (Passan). The reliever tier is clearing out too.
news.title: Twins sign Kevin Ginkel; Nationals add A.J. Puk

news.note: Robert Murray had it first. Cleveland, the smallest payroll in baseball last spring, has now added Griffin and Kris Bubic in two days.
news.title: Guardians bring back Foster Griffin: three years, $48 million

news.note: Jeff Passan had it. Colorado's second multi-year starter of the night after Peterson, for a lefty who missed all of 2025 after elbow surgery.
news.title: Rockies sign Patrick Sandoval: three years, $42 million
